question: Can I get step-free onto the Wonderland-bound platform at Revere Beach right now?
answer: Yes, but not directly at Revere Beach — the Wonderland platform there loses step-free access in the open-data model. The step-free alternative is to enter at Ocean Ave/Shirley Ave, take lift 884, ride the Blue Line to Beachmont, turn around step-free, and ride back to Revere Beach's Wonderland platform (about 17 minutes). There is no backup route avoiding lifts 884, 886, and 887. Check mbta.com/alerts/access.
